'''Gar-Nok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] right hand to the [[Cult of the Screaming Blade]] leader [[Paladius]]. In [[3643 BBY]] he was sent to confront [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] whose own cult ottempted to rival his master's, but was killed in the fight.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gar-Nok appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on Nar Shaddaa.
